about: Round 3 held-out check (2026-10-07): new plain-language questions for 24 existing probes (the 17 that nomic missed at the top 8 in round 2, plus 7 it found). Written before any held-out result was seen, and plain_words.json was not changed afterwards. Each keeps its probe's labels; only the question is new.

questions.NHSSYN001:no-allergies: Has she ever had a reaction to a medication?
questions.NHSSYN001:no-regular-meds: Did she normally take any tablets at home?
questions.NHSSYN002:anaesthesia: What kind of anaesthetic did he have for the knee operation?
questions.NHSSYN002:mobilisation: Was he able to walk after the knee replacement?
questions.NHSSYN002:no-dvt-infection: Were there any problems with clots or the wound afterwards?
questions.NHSSYN002:ward-round-vitals-retained: What were his observations on the ward round on the day of surgery?
questions.NHSSYN003:cxr-findings: What did his first X-ray of the chest show?
questions.NHSSYN003:no-meds-on-admission: Did he use any medicines at home before admission?
questions.NHSSYN003:conservative-management: Was he treated with an operation or managed without one?
questions.NHSSYN003:repeat-cxr-reduction: Was the air in his chest getting less on the repeat X-ray?
questions.NHSSYN003:final-cxr-resolution: Was the chest X-ray clear by the time he left hospital?
questions.NHSSYN003:resp-followup: Who is following him up as an outpatient?
questions.NHSSYN003:neg-haemoptysis: Was there any blood when he coughed?
questions.NHSSYN003:neg-pneumothorax: Did the X-ray show that his lung had collapsed?
questions.NHSSYN003:fam-nil: Do any heart or chest problems run in his family?
questions.NHSSYN001:family-history: Is there a history of illness among her relatives?
questions.NHSSYN002:tinzaparin: Which injection did he get to stop blood clots?
questions.NHSSYN003:recurrence-education: What warning signs should make him come back?
questions.NHSSYN001:neurology-followup: Is she booked to see the neurologists again?
questions.NHSSYN002:followup-appt: When is his next appointment at the clinic?
questions.NHSSYN003:chest-pain: Why did he come to A&E?
questions.NHSSYN001:ct-negative: Was there any bleed on her first head CT?
